title: Inventory: Gou et al. 2019 (Genetics 211:731-740) article and supplement
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/gou2019/raw/`. The user supplied the article PDF
(Gou_et_al_2019_Genetics.pdf, downloaded from academic.oup.com) and the supplement bundle
`7343036.zip` (Figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.7343036, cited in the article), whose four files are
unpacked here untouched; the zip's size and SHA-256 are in `SOURCE_ZIP.tsv`.
The authors' QTL-mapping notebooks and README are in `sources/gou2019/code/`, copied from
github.com/gouliangke/Mutation-rate at commit bcaf987 (see `code/PROVENANCE.txt`); the repository's
genotype and phenotype .Rdata files are not copied.
Statements the ingest uses are quoted verbatim, with page and column, in `extracted/text_facts.tsv`.

roles.Gou_et_al_2019_Genetics.pdf: The article (10 pages): methods, the four mutation-rate QTL (chromosome, direction, variance explained) in the Results text, Table 1 (allele replacement strains), Table 2 (DNA-damaging agents); Figures 1B and 4 plot LOD against the genetic map (no positions tabulated).
roles.Supplemental Figures and Tables.pdf: Supplement (13 pages): Figures S1-S7 (plate image, mutation rate of seven isolates, marker effect sizes, mutagen correlations, H2O2 LOD scan, mutation spectra) and Tables S1-S4 (isolate mutation rates, RAD5 x MKT1 genotype groups, CAN1 amplicon read counts, mutation spectra), plus captions for Files S1-S3.
roles.S1.File_mutation_rate_score.xlsx: File S1: mutation rate score (residual of m) for the 843 mapped segregants, by segregant label.
roles.S2.File_mutation_rate_engineer_strains.x: File S2: mutation rate of 96 replicates for each of six strains (BY, RM, BY:RAD5, RM:MKT1, BY:RAD5-I791S, BY:RAD5-E783D).
roles.S3. Primers_used.docx: File S3: primers for amplifying the CAN1 region (not used by the atlas).

missing: No table of QTL positions, intervals or LOD values: the article and supplement give each QTL by chromosome only, and draw LOD scans against the genetic map (Figures 1B, 4, S5). The authors' notebooks plot the scans and record no peak or interval as output.
No signed effect sizes for the QTL; direction is stated in words, variance explained as percentages in the text.
Mutagen-sensitivity QTL (4NQO, MMS) are described as overlapping the chrXII and chrXIV mutation-rate QTL; H2O2 QTL on other chromosomes are not identified.
No genome build statement (no coordinates are given).
